title: Rate Limiter: Three Algorithms, One Interface
summary: Token bucket, fixed window and sliding-window log behind one RateLimiter interface. Per key, clock-injected and thread-safe.
hints: Token bucket per key: `{tokens, lastRefill}`. On each call: `tokens = min(capacity, tokens + elapsedSeconds * rate)`, then take 1 if `tokens >= 1` (allowing a tiny epsilon for floating-point error).
Fixed window: `windowStart = now - (now % window)`. Reset the count when the stored start differs.
Sliding log: a deque of timestamps per key. Drop entries with `now - ts >= window` before counting.
Concurrency: `ConcurrentHashMap.computeIfAbsent` for per-key state, plus `synchronized` on that state object. In Go, a mutex around the map is enough.
